learning_outcomes.text: Understand the principles of failure in machine elements.
Know the different elements of a machine.
Be able to calculate the different elements of machines.

teaching_methods: Verbal and audiovisual content exposition by faculty

assessment_methods.method: Numerical problems exam (part of final theoretical/practical exam)
Theoretical exam (multiple choice, part of final theoretical/practical exam)

assessment_rules: The final grade is a weighted average of the theoretical/practical exam (70%) and the project work (30%). To pass the course, the score obtained in each assessment component (theory exam, numerical problems exam, and project work) must be greater than 4. Students can optionally take a partial exam for numerical problems in November. Students who do not wish to complete the project work may opt for a substitute exam to obtain the corresponding percentage of the final grade.
